subject.title: Telegram: per-chat lane serialization (isolated ingress) starves messages.queue.collect — same-chat bursts never coalesce

question: Should Telegram same-lane updates that arrive behind an active spooled handler be admitted into the active follow-up/collect queue, or should strict per-lane serialization remain the stronger delivery contract even when collect mode is configured?
rationale: The source confirms the reported boundary, but choosing the fix changes Telegram reliability invariants around durable spool replay, per-lane ordering, and active turn cancellation.

options.title: Design collect-aware lane handoff
options.body: Treat collect mode as intended to coalesce same-chat bursts and design a plugin-owned drain-to-dispatcher handoff with restart/replay safeguards.

options.title: Keep strict lane serialization
options.body: Document that Telegram collect mode cannot coalesce same-lane bursts under isolated ingress and close or narrow the request as an intentional limitation.

options.title: Add opt-in experimental mode
options.body: Preserve current default ordering and add a staged behavior only if maintainers want to test coalescing semantics safely.

recommendation.title: Design collect-aware lane handoff
recommendation.body: Treat collect mode as intended to coalesce same-chat bursts and design a plugin-owned drain-to-dispatcher handoff with restart/replay safeguards.
